records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue was $30.0 billion, up 122% from a year ago and up 15% sequentially.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fueled by the sustained demand for exceptional 3D graphics and the scale of the gaming market, NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for scientific computing, AI, data science, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and 3D internet applications.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sequentially, gross margin decreased primarily driven by inventory provisions for low-yielding Blackwell material and a higher mix of new products within Data Center.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased from a year ago on strong Data Center revenue growth primarily driven by our Hopper GPU computing platform.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Reportable segment operating income – The increase in the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2025 compared to the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2024 in Compute & Networking and Graphics operating income was driven by higher revenue.
